source.title: A Survey of Results and Open Problems on the Schilling Equation

trace.notes: Input normalized as a single zbMATH resolver URL with trailing document id 1748699. Local output metadata and exact-title web resolution identify the exact work as Roland Girgensohn, A Survey of Results and Open Problems on the Schilling Equation, in Functional Equations -- Results and Advances, pages 159-174, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4757-5288-5_12.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. Local shell curl could not resolve zbmath.org, api.crossref.org, or api.openalex.org in the restricted environment. The web page for the Springer DOI exposes only title, abstract, references, citation metadata, and subscription access prompts; direct PDF access redirects back to the chapter landing page rather than yielding a readable PDF.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus page range, exact title plus author, and the ResearchGate identifier found in local checkpoint metadata. The inspected candidates were Springer landing pages, book-store or library table-of-contents pages, blocked/no-readable ResearchGate records, and unrelated or citation-only PDFs that merely cite the chapter. No readable PDF or full HTML source for the same exact chapter was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable primary PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements was recovered. The available abstract and bibliographic pages are inadequate under the source adequacy gate.

Rejected extraction because the only accessible technical text is abstract or citation metadata. The source adequacy and evidence completeness gates require visible full problem statements with locators, so accepted remains empty and the run is marked for review.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1748699.json and outputs/latest.json.
